reader.requirement: At --std 85, a record description holding a format 2 OCCURS under an FD or SD whose RECORD clause has VARYING makes the records variable length, and when the RECORD clause has no DEPENDING ON, WRITE, REWRITE and RELEASE size the record from the current value of the OCCURS data-name-1, for sequential, relative and indexed files, with data-name-1 inside or outside the record.

edition-consulted.switches: the connector's edition: CLOSE WITH LOCK behaviour and the default file-sharing posture (DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility, CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector); it does not touch the record length

reader.edition-search: Grepped SequentialIoEmitter.cs for VaryingLengthArg|DialectLevel|Edition.|EditionContext and the runtime for dialectLevel/edition: the only edition reads on the WRITE/REWRITE path are the connector registration's edition and DialectBehavior.SelectWhenOnlyForFilePhraseStatements, neither of which sizes the record.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c20_odo_record_varying_no_depending covers sequential WRITE, REWRITE (00 and 44) and RELEASE with data-name-1 inside the record; relative and indexed files, WRITE FROM, data-name-1 outside the record, a zero-occurrence record and the WRITE after a failed OPEN are not exercised.

reader.notes: With no RECORD DEPENDING item, VaryingLengthArg yields null and the runtime takes the record image at its current ODO extent (LengthExpr), so the length written is the OCCURS count at the statement for every organization. The connector's edition argument governs sharing and CLOSE WITH LOCK, not the record size.

refuter.evidence: rv1.cob at --std 85: SD with RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 2 TO 6 and an ODO record, no DEPENDING; RELEASE of records with SN=3,0,4 through SORT ... GIVING a VARYING FD, then OPEN EXTEND and WRITE of a second fixed 01 record (PIC X(3)). rv1.out bytes: 02 00 00 00 'A0' / 06 00 00 00 'B4wxyz' / 05 00 00 00 'C3abc' / 03 00 00 00 'XYZ': every record sized from the OCCURS count at RELEASE, kept through SORT, and the other 01 record written at its own size. Reader's probes already covered relative, indexed, outside data-name-1, zero occurrences and a failed OPEN. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR5.
